doc.title: Joe Darensbourg and Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1957-04-18

title: His father the shoemaker and amateur cornetist
summary: His father played E-flat cornet as a hobby in a friends' brass band and was a shoemaker from the small town of Glen.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Was he a professional musician? No, no, no. He wasn't a professional musician.

Mostly as a hobby. They had a brass band among his friends. My father was a shoemaker. Mm-hmm. But they had a brass band among his friends. My father was from a little small town in Louisiana called Glen.
